name: Omaris Cuevas
message: Happy 15th birthday Samantha!! 💕 I hope you have the best birthday ever. I’m so happy and thankful to have you as my best friend. Thank you for always being there for me and being someone I can always count on. I hope God always protects you, guides you, and blesses you with many more years. I hope 15 is an amazing year for you and brings you so much happiness and everything you deserve. Love you so much best friend!!
